metadata.description: Vitalii's personal collection of reusable Claude Code plugins — rules, skills, commands, agents, hooks, and scripts battle-tested at work and reused across projects.

plugins.name: rules
plugins.description: Reusable, language-neutral convention rules (Makefile, env templates, comments, writing-rules) plus a /rules:install command to drop them into any project's .claude/rules/.

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: Reusable, language- and project-neutral skills. Currently: writing-knowledge-docs — durable, code-grounded explanations of how a subsystem works, plus dated decision records.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: A dependency-light status line (model name, git branch, context-usage bar) plus a /statusline:install command to wire it into any project's .claude/.
